title: Surface
description: What is under review, as data: the lines a violation may be reported against, and the call sites into and out of them. The lines are a selection of the change set: on a first-time review the whole change set, on a subsequent review the changes carrying an unresolved comment, carrying a comment the author resolved since the prior review, or new since the prior review. The call sites are the files that mention a changed file or something its changed lines define, and the files a changed file mentions. Every file named here travels to the probes; a probe reads nothing else

files.description: The lines a violation may be reported against

CallSites.description: The files around the change that a verdict may need: context a verdict is reached from, never what it is reported against

into.description: Files outside the change set that mention a changed file or a name its changed lines define: the callers

outOf.description: Files outside the change set that a changed file mentions: the callees
